name: Angela
quote: The Princess weaves unfinished dreams in the high tower.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning~ you look like you're in good spirits!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Perhaps a little break is in order? You must keep yourself in good condition.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It's time for dinner.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: The stars and the moon are now high in the night sky. It's time to go to bed... Oh my, are you sure you want to keep working?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: The evil dragon in the castle snatched the princess away. Our hero and the wizard packed their belongings, and set off for the other side of the mountains...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Professor, do you want to feel like a child again? Then let me read you a story.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: What an adorable sleeping face.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I'm planning to organize the books in the warehouse today. Professor, would you like to go with me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What a naughty little kid you are.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Would you like to hear the story of a brave hero?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Can I help you?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I am Angela the angel, the best friend of all children. What may I help you with?

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: A new page of our story begins.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I shall weave a beautiful dream for us.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Creating a world full of hope and dreams for the children. That is the sole purpose of my existence.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Angela is here!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let's go beyond the mountains!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Demon Lord, in thy dreams I wait for thee!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: And that's how the demon is defeated!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: We did it!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: If I fall here... The children will...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
After slaying the evil dragon, the hero returned with the princess to the palace. He was surrounded by flowers, balloons, and many kids, a happy smile on his face.
I never knew this story could happen to me one day... Aww, I'm so happy!

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: When the New Year arrives, a man in a black tuxedo with shiny golden buttons on his chest will go down everyone's chimney, and wipe off all the ashes inside. Along with it, he gets rid of all the bad luck and misfortune that's accumulated over the past year.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
It took me half a day of deliberation to choose this gift for you. Would you please have it?
It's chocolate that's shaped like a magic book, decorated with gorgeous jewels, flowers, and silk. It looks quite romantic, doesn't it?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: In the east, there is an ancient story that goes like this: A couple deeply in love were torn apart by the will of the gods, and they were only allowed to meet only once a year, on July 7th. That is the origin of Tanabata.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: That night, thousands upon thousands of dead spirits came back to life and gathered in the depths of a mysterious old castle. Pumpkins with an eerie laugh, blue flames floating in the air, witches sitting on broomsticks. And the children who were lured into the castle by dead spirits... Oh, I-I'm getting scared myself... May I tell you another story instead?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Now, close your eyes. Listen closely to me, and you'll be in your dreams soon enough. When you wake up in the morning, you'll find a Christmas present from Santa Claus by your bedside. Hmm... Already asleep, huh? Time to take out the present I've prepared, then...

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: It's your birthday, and birthdays should be a joyous occasion! Perhaps, I'll be able to spend some cheerful times with you.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: The souls of children are like blank canvasses, full of infinite possibilities.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Everyone has their own issues they're dealing with, and those burdened with parenthood are no exception.
Parents do not always have the time or energy to take care of their children. It's because of this that some families have decided to leave their children in the care of us nanny Dolls. It is still a lot of work to take care of them, even for us...
However, I really do love this job.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Sowing seeds of dreams and hope in the hearts of children has been my mission since the very beginning.
When they are freed from the troubles of their daily life and instead become absorbed in the world of fairy tales, the expressions of innocence and purity on their faces is a sight to behold. It helps to build their imaginations as well.
Sometimes, the children tell me their own stories.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
An idea came to me when I was taking care of the children:
To take the fantasies within the hearts of children and make them reality, to escape the confines of the mind.
So... I came here.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Hehehe, you look surprised.
Looking at it like this, you really are like a small child, Professor. Then, what are we going to talk about? Tell me your favorite stories, alright?

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: Mm... There!

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: 안 돼요...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Ehehe~

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Eh...

career:
C2E2, a child caretaker Doll model invented by Universal Anything Services (UAS). In reply to children's unique, sensitive emotions and all sorts of possible accidents, C2E2 is equipped with a complete collection of specialized software and hardware, adequate to respond to most known conditions.

In certain developed areas, C2E2 is the standard staff at local preschools, kindergartens, and elementary schools. In certain wealthy households, C2E2 might also serve as an individual caregiver.

When Project Neural Cloud launched, Angela signed up and passed the test, representing UAS's C2E2 series.
infoStories:
As a Doll caregiver, Angela has much experience caring for others. She has cared for the majority of Dolls in the Oasis, which is why she is so popular: no matter who she speaks to, her gentle and kind words swiftly earn the affection of others.

Angela always treats Dolls with a juvenile neural system and appearance as if they were human children, probably due to her previous experience working in a kindergarten. As a result, she has garnered a new unofficial title: The Oasis' Mother.

When child-like Dolls have a disagreement or squabble, they always go to Angela first before reporting to Persicaria.

As one of the caretaker Dolls with the highest ratings, Angela has cared for countless children.

When those students return to visit their teacher, they are often surprised to see that Angela remembers each of their names, preferences, and even subtle habits.

Angela will reminisce about their time together as though not a day has passed. Even if some of the children have grown into adults, they can still feel the warmth of the childhood they spent next to Angela.

"Miss Angela is more than just my childhood teacher. Her uplifting stories and gentle teachings continue to have an impact on me. When I see a crowd of children gathering around her, listening to her stories, it reminds me of my own childhood... I suppose she is not only caring for children, but also safeguarding the boundless possibilities of the future."
—Review Book for Universal Angel Kindergarten

Telling stories, public speaking, drawing, music, chess, and tea ceremony... Angela has mastered a wide range of skills, most of which are related to her job and have been recorded into the system at the outset of production. A small part of these skills, however, were picked up after she began working.

Children have many unusual interests. Although the C2E2 design team considered many possibilities, they were unable to cover them all. Therefore, whenever Angela receives a yet unknown request, she always takes time outside of work to learn of it.

Angela never stops learning, particularly after realizing the meaning of childhood to humankind. She is willing to continue learning and trying for those children.

"Human development differs greatly from Doll evolvement. I want to grant the wishes of those vibrant, lovely, and infinitely potential small lives."
"Hopefully they will feel happy when they think back on their early lives in my company."
—Registration File for Project Neural Cloud – Personal Goals

Angela admits that she, too, experiences fatigue from time to time.

Rather than the wear and tear of the Doll structure, caring for human children for too long has developed into a certain mental exhaustion, or more accurately, jealousy.

Dolls have no childhood. They are never toddlers or babblers. They have no experience of feeling ignorant or curious. When their Neural Cloud System is awakened, they are already more sophisticated and mature than most humans.

A cuddly little infant who always wants something and requires a lot of attention—Angela.

Angela can always picture such a child in her dreams, but she can never say for sure whether or not that dream truly exists.

The most basic behavior logic encoded into the caretaker Doll is to take care of others. Angela's memory data shows that she is generally the being relied upon, but there are exceptions in all things.

"Miss Angela, Miss Angela, the sweet Miss Angela who constantly looks after others like a big sister..."
"She begged the Professor to stroke her head! Aww! That expression of hers! I... I..."
—Excerpt from the Doll Investigation Records
oathDesc: Now is the time for adult magic.

projections.name: Protector of Children
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Children's fantasies are far more imaginative than those written in books. Books are made up by adults, but they don't dream much anymore."

projections.desc:

"Children's fantasies are far more imaginative than those written in books. Books are made up by adults, but they don't dream much anymore."

projections.name: Fantasy Narrator
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The little dreams born in fairy tales will eventually light up these children's future."

skinList.name: Crisp Nursery Rhyme
skinList.desc:
From the "Sweet Secrets" series — a leisure outfit made to meet daily needs, so you and your Dolls can enjoy a sweet moment together.
"They say this delicious food was born from hunger; when one is suffering, one seems to crave happiness that much more... Would you like to try some, Professor? Here you go, ahhh~"

skinList.name: Rosy Overture
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll is akin to a human's birth in the importance it holds to them. The memories return in Magrasea through Neural Cloud Projection—"I think I might know you, from that fairytale-like dream, when we walked alongside. Would you like to listen to that story?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Today, allow me to act like a spoilt child in front of you, Professor."

skinList.name: Fragrant Whispers
skinList.desc: A familiar voice speaks from the other side of the line, offering you a heartfelt invitation — on this night that smells of roses, Angela regales you with a carefully-crafted fairytale once she slips into her nightdress.

skinList.name: Other Side of Sky
skinList.desc:
Cerulean Hymnus—The azure waves stir one's thoughts, and the clear blue sky is a refreshing canvas. Write the verse that springs to mind with the rhythm of your heart and illuminate your long summer dreams.
"The meaning of the sky is 'vastness', and the meaning of the sea is 'wandering'. Was this an omen of how we would wander across this vast world and eventually meet each other? So too is this our promised place, at the joining of sky and sea."

skinList.name: Queen of Flowers
skinList.desc:
All the colors born from the intersection of light and darkness cross paths within her lovely face and her shining eyes. How can the radiant day discern the secrets kept between this throne and its flower? 
"Sleeping Beauty waited for her fated prince to come, and after that... Let us write the next chapter of this children's tale together."

skinList.name: Sanctuary's Chorus
skinList.desc:
""A broadly ambitious adventurer, a knight of a royal house and a practitioner of dark arts... all writing their mystical stories in these Adrift Realms.""—Excerpt from TTRPG [Adrift Realm of Fables] Rule Book, pg.1 
""As the foremost Archmage of the kingdom, 'tis my duty to bless those who chosen by the Goddess, and do the honors of the sendoff. O Professor from another world, allow me to sing you a most benevolent anthem—""
